_doc: Each metric keeps observations per credibility tier. The headline is the latest `confirmed` observation; other tiers are shown alongside, never summed into it. `approx` marks values given as 'about/nearly'. `concern`: 'up' means an increase is a worsening signal; 'none' means changes are informational (e.g. number of tests run).

definition.zh: 经官方实验室检测确认的鼠疫病例。俄罗斯当局称未检出鼠疫病原体。
definition.en: Plague cases confirmed by official laboratory testing. Russian authorities say no plague pathogen has been detected.

note.zh: 俄方向世卫组织通报：伊尔库茨克州未登记鼠疫病例
note.en: Russia told WHO no plague case is registered in Irkutsk oblast

definition.zh: 公开提及可能为鼠疫、但未经实验室确认的病例，包括目前唯一的死者。“第二名员工患病”属未证实报道，单独列出。
definition.en: Cases publicly linked to possible plague but not lab-confirmed, including the one death so far. The reported second ill employee is unverified and shown separately.

note.zh: 第二例的说法已被官方否认，世卫组织仍在询问
note.en: Second case officially denied; WHO question still open

definition.zh: 官方确认的死亡人数，死因未必是鼠疫。官方死因为“病因不明的肺炎”。
definition.en: Officially confirmed deaths, whatever the cause. The official cause is “pneumonia of undetermined etiology”.

note.zh: 第二例死亡的说法已被官方否认

definition.zh: 仍在接受医学观察或隔离的接触者人数。高峰时媒体报道约 197 人；官方 10 月 8 日称所有接触者已结束观察。
definition.en: Contacts still under medical observation or isolation. Media reported about 197 at the peak; officials said on 8 Oct all contacts had been released.

note.zh: 所有接触者已结束观察

definition.zh: 官方公布的累计实验室检测数量及结果。
definition.en: Cumulative laboratory tests and results reported by officials.

note.zh: 全部未检出危险病原体
多种方法检测，均未检出危险病原体

definition.zh: 据报道实施检疫或接诊限制的医疗机构数量。官方否认“大规模关闭医院”。
definition.en: Medical facilities reported to have quarantine or admission restrictions. Officials deny “mass hospital closures”.

note.zh: 州长宣布解除检疫（未点名具体机构）
note.en: Governor says quarantine lifted (facilities not named)

note.zh: 世卫组织 10 月 7 日表示，俄方提供的信息尚不足以完成全面风险评估。
note.en: On 7 Oct WHO said Russia had not yet shared enough information for a full risk assessment.
